company_overview: Arize AI is a continual learning platform that provides observability, evaluation, and experimentation tools for AI agents and LLM applications. Notable for its foundational role in the OpenInference open standard for GenAI observability and its open-source Phoenix project, which together have reached 5 million downloads per month.
target_audience: AI engineers and teams building and deploying LLM-based applications, AI agents, and multi-modal systems in production.

company_overview: Google is a multinational technology company that develops search, advertising, cloud computing, and AI products and services. It is notable for its family of AI products, including the Gemini model line used for agentic workflows and cybersecurity, spanning Search, Google Workspace, and Google Cloud.
target_audience: General public and businesses worldwide, including advertisers, developers, enterprises, nonprofits, individuals using Search and Google Workspace, and organizations solving business challenges with Google Cloud.

company_overview: Facebook is a social media platform that allows users to connect, share, and discover content, alongside a suite of related products including Messenger, Meta AI, Instagram, and Meta Quest. It is operated by Meta Platforms, a technology conglomerate that spans social networking, artificial intelligence, virtual and augmented reality hardware, and digital commerce.
target_audience: General consumers and businesses globally who want to communicate with friends, family, and customers through social media, advertising, and messaging.
